senses.gloss: a person acting for an AI
gloss_distractors: a robot working in a factory
a server that relays web traffic
a test user for an app
senses.definition: A person who does tasks in the real world on behalf of an AI or a remote system.
senses.caution: Informal, and it can sound demeaning to the person. Use it among colleagues who know the joke, and avoid it in writing to a client.
senses.example: The agent cannot sign for the delivery, so I am its meat proxy for the afternoon.

cues.text: An AI agent has planned a whole task but cannot open a physical lockbox, so it asks you to go and do it. You joke about the role you are playing for the agent.
In a demo, a coworker types whatever the model tells them to type, clicks where it says to click, and reports back what happens. What informal two-word name describes their role?
A friend says an AI chatbot planned their whole trip and all they did was show up and follow orders, as the hands and feet of a program. What slang two-word name fits them?

distractors: A person who speaks up in public for someone else.
A senior person who actively backs a colleague and helps them move ahead at work.
Someone who does things differently from everyone before them.
A leader whose calm and confident style makes people trust them in difficult situations.
A small team of experts that is paid to help the rest of the company.
